{"metadata":{"description":"DeepSeek Lens is a high-performance, deterministic AST code graph and architectural analysis tool plugin designed for the DeepSeek Harness agent foundation.","id":"gh:1336985072","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-tool-lens","slug":"trench-xinxin/dsh-tool-lens","topics":["ast","code-graph","deepseek","deepseek-harness","dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"DeepSeek Lens is a high-performance, deterministic AST code graph and architectural analysis tool pl"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"ugin designed for the DeepSeek Harness agent foundation."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# DeepSeek Lens (`@trench-xinxin/dsh-tool-lens`)"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 简体中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"**DeepSeek Lens** is a high-performance, deterministic AST code graph and architectural analysis too"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"l plugin designed for the **DeepSeek Harness** agent foundation."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"It empowers AI Agents with deep codebase topological awareness, enabling instant module dependency e"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"xploration, disambiguated symbol call hierarchies, OOP inheritance tracing, circular dependency audi"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"ts, architectural coupling metrics, Git diff change impact audits, domain architecture slicing, and "},{"id":"p5s4","text":"full-stack API contract tracking."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## ⚡ Zero-Config All-in-One Launcher (No Extra Setup Required)"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"> 💡 **Stand-alone Execution**: You **do NOT need to pre-install `@deepseek-ai/dsh`**, nor do you nee"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"d to start any background Harness services beforehand.
> Running the command below will automaticall"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"y download the runtime, handle port allocation, and launch the complete Web UI with Lens pre-loaded:"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"Once launched, your browser can access the Web UI at the indicated local address (e.g. `http://127.0"},{"id":"p9s2","text":".0.1:3080` or `http://127.0.0.1:3081`)."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## 🌟 Core Features (v2.0)"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"1. **📦 Module & Dependency Topology (`dependencies`)**
- Precise static analysis of ES and CommonJS "},{"id":"p11s2","text":"`import` / `export` declarations.
- **Full Re-export Resolution**: Supports `export * from './mod'` "},{"id":"p11s3","text":"and named aliased re-exports.
- **Path Mapping**: Automatically resolves `tsconfig.json` `compilerOp"},{"id":"p11s4","text":"tions.paths` aliases (e.g., `@/*`)."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"2. **📞 Scope-Disambiguated Call Hierarchies (`call_graph`)**
- Resolves functions, arrow functions, "},{"id":"p12s2","text":"and class member methods.
- **4-Tier Scope Awareness**: Prioritizes same-file, explicit imports (`im"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"port { fn }`), and namespace imports (`Mod.fn`), completely eliminating false positives from duplica"},{"id":"p12s4","text":"te function names across the workspace.
- **OOP Heritage Extraction**: Extracts `extends` and `imple"},{"id":"p12s5","text":"ments` relations for classes and interfaces."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"3. **💥 Tiered Refactoring Blast-Radius Analysis (`impact`)**
- Assesses downstream and upstream impa"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"ct of changing or removing symbols.
- **3-Tier Risk Classification**:
- 🔴 **Tier 0 Direct Breaking**"},{"id":"p13s3","text":": External callers and direct importers breaking on signature changes.
- 🟡 **Tier 1 Internal Cascadi"},{"id":"p13s4","text":"ng**: Functions/methods within the same file/class affected by cascade.
- 🔵 **Tier 2 Transitive Impo"},{"id":"p13s5","text":"rters**: Upstream modules transitively importing this file."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"4. **🔄 Circular Dependency Auditing (`circular`)**
- Tarjan SCC and DFS cycle detection algorithm de"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"tects closed loops (e.g. `A -> B -> C -> A`).
- Outputs full cycle loops and involved file lists to "},{"id":"p14s3","text":"avoid runtime initialization deadlocks."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"5. **🧭 Shortest Call Path Exploration (`action: path`)**
- Bidirectional BFS algorithm traces shorte"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"st execution paths and intermediate hops between any two symbols."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"6. **🧹 Dead Code & Unused Symbol Audit (`action: unused`)**
- Discovers unreferenced symbols and orp"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"han files with zero afferent callers ($Ca = 0$)."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"7. **🛡 Architecture Layer Governance (`action: lint`)**
- Enforces architectural boundary rules (e.g"},{"id":"p17s2","text":". `views/**` cannot directly import `infra/**`) to prevent layer decay."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"8. **📝 Git Diff Impact & Test Recommender (`action: diff_impact`)**
- Scans uncommitted working tree"},{"id":"p18s2","text":" diffs or commit ranges, traces upstream breaking callers, and **recommends targeted regression test"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"commit ranges, traces upstream breaking callers, and **recommends targeted regression test suites**."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"9. **🧩 Domain Architecture Subgraph Slicing (`action: slice`)**
- Extracts compact, high-cohesion do"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"main slices (Ego-Networks) around seed symbols, computing cohesion scores and boundary dependencies."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"10. **🌐 Full-Stack Cross-Language API Contracts (`action: api_contracts`)**
- Automatically links fr"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"ontend HTTP requests (`fetch`, `axios`, `request`) to backend route controllers (Java Spring, Python"},{"id":"p20s3","text":" FastAPI, Go Gin), forming full-stack end-to-end call graphs."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"11. **🌍 Polyglot Ecosystem Drivers (`Java / Python / Go / Rust / TS / SFC`)**
- **Java (`.java`)**: "},{"id":"p21s2","text":"`package`, Maven/Gradle paths, `class`, `interface`, `extends`, `implements`, and class method invoc"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"ations.
- **Python (`.py`)**: `def`, `class` inheritance, `self.method()`, and relative/absolute pac"},{"id":"p21s4","text":"kage imports.
- **Go (`.go`)**: `package` scopes, `go.mod` module paths, Struct Embedding, and Recei"},{"id":"p21s5","text":"ver methods.
- **Rust (`.rs`)**: `mod` modules, `struct`, `trait`, `impl Trait for Struct`, and meth"},{"id":"p21s6","text":"od calls.
- **Vue 3 & Svelte (`.vue`, `.svelte`)**: Full support for `<script setup>` and `<template"},{"id":"p21s7","text":">` component references."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## 📄 License"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"MIT License © 2026 Trench / DeepSeek Lens Contributors."}],"truncated":false}
